CORE-01.notes: Verified 2026-08-01 on master. Chrome/96.0.4664.110 is gone; FINGERPRINT_CATALOG ships 3 modern profiles (Chrome 138/139) with locale, timezone_id, Accept-Language, languages and navigator.platform aligned per profile. build_fingerprint_profile seeds random.Random from sha256(account) so a fingerprint is deterministic per account and differs across accounts (alice=America/New_York vs bob=Europe/London). Stealth init script patches navigator.webdriver to undefined plus language/languages/platform/plugins/window.chrome. All LinkedIn CSS selectors centralised in linkedin_mcp/browser/selectors.py with ordered fallbacks and consumed by linkedin_browser_mcp.py. 3 dedicated tests pass, including a regression test asserting selectors stay centralised.

CORE-02.notes: Verified 2026-08-01 on master. Now uses chromium.launch_persistent_context against a per-account profile dir (sessions/<platform>_<sha256[:12]>_profile), so localStorage and IndexedDB persist, not just cookies. THE PATH BUG IS FIXED: save_cookies and load_cookies both resolve through session_cookie_path(), anchored to REPO_ROOT via Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]. Smoke test confirms the path is identical and absolute before and after chdir to a temp dir, so the destructive unlink-on-load-failure path can no longer trigger from a different cwd. Legacy encrypted cookies are imported once when the profile dir is empty. Per-account proxy binding resolves in order explicit arg > LINKEDIN_PROXY_<ACCOUNT> > LINKEDIN_PROXY, confirmed by smoke test. Profile dirs and cookie files chmod 0o700/0o600. tests/test_session.py 2/2 pass.

DB-01.notes: Verified 2026-08-01 on master (merge point c97aab5). linkedin_mcp/core/migrations/0001_init.sql creates all 25 spec tables; schema_migrations is created by the runner, giving 26 total. Smoke test run from a non-repo cwd: journal_mode=wal, foreign_keys=1, 26 tables, applied=['0001_init'], re-run applied [] so migrations are forward-only and idempotent. Runner splits statements via sqlite3.complete_statement and rolls the whole migration back on failure. tests/test_db.py 2/2 pass.
